subjects.label: Co-driver and pace notes
subjects.description: The co-driver and the pace notes: the phrasing of the calls, following or ignoring what is called, the voice and accent in your ear and the calls players quote back; not the soundtrack or the engine sound, which belong under audio.

subjects.label: Roadside hazards
subjects.description: What stands beside the road and ends a stage on contact: trees, rocks, logs, ditches and drops, and how a metre off the line is punished; not the car tumbling itself, which has its own row.

subjects.label: Rolling the car
subjects.description: The car flipping, somersaulting and finishing on its roof, whether laughed about or blamed on a tiny bump; not striking scenery, which belongs under roadside hazards.

subjects.label: Handling physics and realism
subjects.description: Whether the driving physics feel like real rallying: sim against arcade, how the car behaves on the road and whether that is believable; not how hard the stages are, which belongs under difficulty.

subjects.label: Cars and favourites
subjects.description: Which cars are in the game, which are missing or wanted, and which car players swear by or warn against; not whether the cars carry official licences.

subjects.label: Steering wheels and force feedback
subjects.description: Playing on a steering wheel: which wheels are detected, force feedback settings, and setting up a handbrake; not gamepad or keyboard controls in general.

subjects.label: The first game and the series
subjects.description: Comparison with the previous game in the series and with its lineage, including what was dropped between releases; not comparisons with other racing games.

subjects.label: Concentration and nerves
subjects.description: The sustained focus a stage demands and the stress it produces: sweaty palms, no distractions, nerves worn down by the conditions; not general immersion or mood.

subjects.label: Career and championship
subjects.description: The career and championship mode: progression through cars and events, what players want added to it, and career progress lost along the way; not single stages or time trials.
